visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a dark grey cap featuring a graphic patch and a brown-and-black plaid flannel shirt over a pink graphic tee, stands in a large, brightly lit indoor area. He holds a yellow-and-white cardboard box depicting SpongeBob SquarePants with a large afro. Behind him is a life-sized white statue with black web-like details. (2) The man carefully peels open the top flaps of the box using both hands. He pulls out a silver foil bag and looks directly into the camera lens with a wide, open-mouthed grin, displaying his teeth. His eyes are bright and focused. He is in a crowded retail or exhibition environment with soft overhead lighting and shoppers in the background. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of a collector card featuring the 'Afro Spongebob' character. The man's hands hold the card steadily. Then, the camera focuses on a small yellow plastic figure of SpongeBob with a voluminous black curly afro and a red headband, standing on a blue base. Other similar figurines are visible on shelves behind it. (4) The man walks in front of a giant purple and pink backdrop featuring a large portrait of Harley Quinn from 'Suicide Squad.' He carries a red-and-white Hot Toys paper shopping bag. He strikes several poses, including peace signs and pointing gestures, while smiling enthusiastically. The area has high ceilings and white structural beams. (5) A rapid series of shots showcases various collectible toys in glass cases: a realistic John Wick figure in a suit, a James Bond figure holding a rifle, a white-and-black Spider-Man statue, and several 'Dandadan' themed cat figurines and plushies. The lighting in the cases is bright and directed to highlight the textures of the figures. (6) The man stands before a giant green Grogu (Baby Yoda) figure and gives two thumbs up while wearing a black backpack. He then holds another blind box, a 'Disney Halloween' series, and begins the unboxing process again, showing the illustrated duck character on the packaging to the camera.
